title: Coming Into Focus
summary:
So, either there is a fiscal package soon and risk assets move higher
or inflation expectations trend lower, forcing the Fed to use more bullets. The rate at which we discount future cash flows depends on the risks involved in waiting for them. These include the risk of actual loss, as well as the loss of purchasing power to
inflation.
